title: How Ten Minutes of Silence Rewires a Godly Man's Self-Control
caption:
Self-control isn't a personality trait some guys got and you didn't. It's built, in the quiet room before the moment you actually need it.

Ten minutes of silence a day. No phone, no noise, just you and God. That's the whole practice. It shows up later as the pause before you react.

Try it tomorrow morning before you touch your phone.

#godlyman #selfcontrol #discipline #christianmen #biblicalmanhood #stillness
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
